intervals.label: proposed (Snowmass 2021 contribution)
intervals.note: This is the date of the Snowmass planning-document proposal, not a formal experiment-approval date; no source consulted (checked 2026-10-25: arXiv:2203.08322 and a web search for later announcements) states that DarkQuest has been formally approved or scheduled.

name: DarkQuest
notes: Derived lists (detector_ids, site_ids, result_ids, document_ids) are not stored in this record; they are derived from the other records.

collaboration_ids is empty: no source consulted (checked 2026-10-25) names a distinct 'DarkQuest Collaboration' separate from the SeaQuest/SpinQuest proponents, so no DarkQuest collaboration record exists.

The cited source's own title ('DarkQuest: A dark sector upgrade to SpinQuest at the 120 GeV Fermilab Main Injector', arXiv:2203.08322) and abstract say DarkQuest upgrades SpinQuest (Fermilab E-1039, the spin-physics successor to SeaQuest that reuses the same spectrometer); the abstract does not mention SeaQuest at all. The lineage therefore carries no `upgrade_of experiment:seaquest` row, because the source does not say that. No SpinQuest experiment record exists, so the SpinQuest relationship is recorded only in prose (this note, `unique_capabilities` and `summary`), not as a lineage row.

No separate detector record exists: DarkQuest is described as reusing the SeaQuest/SpinQuest apparatus at site:fermilab-nm4-hall (see experiment:seaquest and detector:seaquest), and no source consulted (checked 2026-10-25) describes DarkQuest-specific hardware changes in enough detail to justify one.
status is `proposed` because the only source found is a 2021/2022 Snowmass community-planning contribution, not an approval document; do not read this as an active or under-construction programme.

physics_goals.quote: DarkQuest is a proton fixed-target experiment with leading sensitivity to an array of visible dark sector signatures
physics_goals.value: Search for visible decays of dark-sector particles (e.g. dark photons, axion-like particles, dark scalars) with leading sensitivity, reusing existing Fermilab accelerator and detector infrastructure

summary.plain: DarkQuest is a proposed Fermilab experiment that would reuse the SeaQuest particle detector to search for hidden, dark-sector particles instead of ordinary quarks, at low cost since it builds on equipment already installed.
summary.technical: Proposed dark-sector upgrade (Snowmass 2021 contribution, arXiv:2203.08322) to the SeaQuest/SpinQuest spectrometer at the 120 GeV Fermilab Main Injector, targeting visible decays of dark photons, axion-like particles and dark scalars in the MeV-GeV mass range; no source consulted (checked 2026-10-25) reports a formal approval.

unique_capabilities.quote: builds off of existing accelerator and detector infrastructure
unique_capabilities.value: A proposed dark-sector upgrade/run mode of the existing SeaQuest/SpinQuest spectrometer, offering 'powerful but modest-cost' new physics reach on a short timescale by reusing installed accelerator and detector infrastructure rather than building a new facility
